events.verdict: Haliburton (IND) places both hands on Miller (CHA) and immediately removes them without affecting his SQBR.
After the release of Green's (CHA) driving shot attempt, Mathurin (IND) places a hand on his body as he returns to the floor and the contact is marginal.
Green (CHA) leans into Haliburton (IND) on the perimeter, but the contact is marginal.
Miller (CHA) has an extended hand placed on Nembhard (ND) and he releases as he receives the pass.
As Miller (CHA) drives past Nembhard (IND), he loses his footing on his own accord. Any contact from Nembhard is incidental.
Siakam (IND) jumps vertically and absorbs the contact initiated by Martin (CHA) during his layup attempt.
Wong (CHA) maintains a legal guarding position during McConnell's (IND) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Nembhard (IND) briefly grasps Miller's (CHA) arm but the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Nembhard (IND) contests the driving shot attempt by Miller (CHA) and the contact with his head is marginal.
Wong (CHA) reaches in-between Haliburton's (IND) arm and the ball and makes contact with the ball, causing it to become loose. Any ensuing contact with Haliburton's arm is incidental.

Replay review of the foul called on Micić (CHA) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Micic and Haliburton (IND) both pursue the loose ball and the contact is incidental. Due to imminent possession, Charlotte is awarded possession of the ball upon the resumption of play.
McConnell (IND) reaches in and initiates contact to Micic's (CHA) arm that causes him to lose control of the ball.
McConnell (IND) briefly places an arm to Wong's (CHA) front and the contact is marginal.
After establishing the ball in the frontcourt, Wong (CHA) loses possession and regains control in the backcourt. McConnell (IND) never makes any contact with the ball.
Haliburton (IND) releases away from Wong (CHA) as he comes to a stop.
Mathurin (IND) places his off-arm against Martin (CHA), but does not prevent him from contesting the layup attempt.
Nembhard (IND) initiates illegal lower body contact with Green (CHA) as he returns to the floor.
Wong (CHA) and Haliburton (IND) briefly engage and disengage.
Wong (CHA) commits a take foul on Haliburton (IND).
Turner (IND) commits a take foul on Miller (CHA).
Turner (IND) briefly grasps Richards' (CHA) arm before immediately releasing.
